objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: square, triangular and honeycomb n x n tori (n = 4, 5, 6) and their line networks under every self-blind law: binding (A32) at every lag (affine laws, exact) or to lag 6 (nonlinear, SAT); and under the eight symmetric nonlinear laws and law (12, 12), needing both rings at every lag to 64 and the plain first need, exact by witnesses and SAT; testing that no law that sees its rings binds, and that the nonlinear laws read the tori's distance plainly.

title: Laws that see their rings, on the lattice tori: a census
